caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a natural, brown wood grain finish. The cabinet has an arched, crown-like top, decorated with a carved sunburst motif. Below the arch, there is a broad, open shelf area with a decorative trim along the front edge. Beneath this shelf section, the main body of the cabinet includes a slanted writing surface, suggesting it may serve as a desk or storage unit. At the bottom, there are two rectangular doors with recessed panels and visible grain patterns, fitted with small round knobs as handles. The cabinet sits on a flat base, and the overall shape is rectangular with the exception of the curved top. The perspective is slightly angled, showing both the front and some of the right side. The drawing is rendered with careful attention to the texture, color variations, and patterns of the wood, with the background left plain and uncolored. Near the bottom right corner, there is a handwritten signature and date: "Edward I. Lopez Del. 1880."
title: Childs's Dresser
